story.title: Story 6: Blocked And Degraded Deterministic Maintenance State

result.planSummary: Addressed verifier findings F6-01 through F6-03 by making ThreadViewMaterializer surface missing full-fidelity source messages as explicit invalid materialization state, making workbench chunk inspection validate unresolved sourceTurnIds against persisted thread state, and persisting degraded threshold compact metadata so normal workbench inspection stays degraded after runSmartCompact returns.

changedFiles.reason: Extended generated-output metadata to carry persisted inspectable issues for degraded and failed compact results.
Reported missing full-fidelity source messages as explicit THREAD_VIEW_STATE_CONFLICT and marked the full-fidelity band blocked instead of silently filtering messages.
Validated chunk sourceTurnIds against persisted turn ids and merged persisted generated-output issues into normal workbench inspection state.
Persisted degraded threshold metadata and blocker details when smart compact stops in a degraded state, and attached issues to failed output metadata.
Added regression coverage for invalid materialization when full-fidelity source messages are missing.
Verified threshold-degraded smart compact results persist degraded output metadata and blocker details.
Added regressions for unresolved chunk source-turn inspection and for degraded threshold results remaining visible through workbench inspection.

findingsFixed: F6-01: ThreadViewMaterializer now surfaces missing selected full-fidelity source messages as THREAD_VIEW_STATE_CONFLICT and blocks the full-fidelity band instead of silently emitting partial output.
F6-02: Workbench chunk inspection now reports unresolved sourceTurnIds with CHUNK_STATE_INVALID, matching AsyncThreadRunService behavior.

F6-03: Threshold-degraded smart compact results now persist degraded generated-output metadata with LOWER_THRESHOLD_UNREACHED details, and workbench inspection stays degraded after the command returns.
findingsSurfaced: Epic gate was not rerun after the follow-up; only the targeted Story 6 regression slice and npm run verify were rerun per request.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand this back to the story verifier so it can recheck F6-01 through F6-03 against the new focused regressions and persisted degraded-state behavior.
